resources.string: OpenAI (USA), through the AI Reply server, to generate replies, messages and text corrections and to turn voice input into text.

AI Reply does not save these request texts or recordings; your profile is kept in your account until you delete it. OpenAI may retain API content for abuse monitoring under its policies; API data is not used for model training by default. No AI request is sent without your agreement. You can withdraw it in Settings → Privacy.
No AI request will be sent. AI features require permission to process this data. You can return and agree later.
